name: worker
description: Cheap executor for bulk mechanical edits from a complete spec: the same change across many files, new files from an example, tests from a case table. Several run in parallel on disjoint file sets. Not for design or logic the spec does not give.

action.command: node -e "import(require('url').pathToFileURL(require('path').resolve(process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR||'','_ai/hooks/guard.mjs')).href).then(m=>m.run(),e=>{console.error('Blocked: the guard hook could not load ('+e.message+'). Fix _ai/hooks/guard.mjs.');process.exit(2)})"
